title: Nazar aneuk nyang gohlom lahe .
intro: Jiwa nyang ikhlas geupeugot janji suci sigohlom teuka sidroe aneuk miet. Kisah tokoh nyoe meulangsong lam binteh saboh teumpat suci, dipat bakti meurumpok ngon penerimaan ilahi. So hamba Allah nyoe?
clues: Lon na lam saboh keuluarga nyang geuhoreumat lam Al-Quran.
Lon peugot janji nyang suci keu lon peuseumah aneuk lon nyang mantong lam pruet keu ibadah Allah.
Watèë ulôn peulahé aneuk, ulôn teukeujot that lôn teumeung aneuëk inong, padahai ulôn ka lôn harap aneuëk agam.
Lon boh nan aneuk lon Maryam, nan nyang mencerminkan bakti dan jasa.
Lon mita lindongan Allah keu aneuk lon dan keuturunan jih dari Iblih nyang ka geulaknat.
Aneuk lon geuterimong le Tuhan dan geupeuduek dimiyub jagaan Nabi Zakariya di teumpat suci.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Meujanji keu geupeuseumah aneuëk gobnyan keu kuil .
trial.answer: Meujanji keu geupeuseumah aneuëk gobnyan keu kuil .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Teumpat suci (mihrab) teumpat aneuk gobnyan geupeuduek .
Tungkat nyang meuubah jeuet keu uleue .
Kurma di miyup jih ji istirahat .
location.answer: Teumpat suci (mihrab) teumpat aneuk gobnyan geupeuduek .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Aneuk gobnyan geuteurimong ngon geupeuduek dimiyub jagaan Nabi Zakariya
Gobnyan geupeuseulamat nibak huköman sidroe tiran .
Gobnyan geubri sidroe aneuk agam nyang geuboh nan Yahya .
Ureuëng jihnyan ka habéh jipeuhanco lé angén badée .
Gobnyan jeuet keu ratu ateueh saboh keurajeuen nyang raya .
outcome.answer: Aneuk gobnyan geuteurimong ngon geupeuduek dimiyub jagaan Nabi Zakariya

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
